decision_register.title: Score-level standardisation before penalised Cox
decision_register.current_frozen_state: NONE before the Cox model (penalisation handles scale). If added later it is training-fold-only.
decision_register.blocks_what: the penalised Cox specification in Phase 6B §3.2; nothing else
decision_register.implication: The five scores sit on very different scales: SD 0.554 (E2F) down to 0.185 (PI3K), because averaging k standardised genes shrinks dispersion by roughly 1/sqrt(k) times the set's coherence. A ridge or elastic-net penalty applies the SAME penalty per unit coefficient, so on unstandardised scores a low-dispersion predictor needs a LARGER coefficient to express the same effect and is therefore shrunk harder. Leaving the scores on their current scales is a defensible choice, but it is a CHOICE with consequences for relative shrinkage, not a neutral default.
options_not_chosen: standardise scores inside each training fold only
standardise and report both as a prespecified sensitivity analysis
decision_register.constraint: any standardisation must be training-fold-only; a full-cohort score standardisation would reintroduce the leakage the frozen rule exists to prevent

decision_register.title: Four-set primary vs five-set sensitivity reporting
decision_register.current_frozen_state: 4-set PRIMARY, 5-set SENSITIVITY-only; PI3K may not be promoted or removed on observed performance (M2-A1)
decision_register.blocks_what: nothing; it is a reporting-framework decision
decision_register.implication: Adding PI3K raises the condition number 2.95 -> 7.03 and introduces the only |r| > 0.5 pair (P53-PI3K, 0.631). A divergence between the primary and sensitivity results is therefore FORESEEABLE and should have a reading rule fixed BEFORE any outcome is seen, or the choice between them becomes a post-hoc selection.
proposed_reporting_framework_not_a_chang: report the 4-set result as primary ALWAYS, whatever the 5-set shows
report the 5-set alongside it, never instead of it
state in advance that a divergence is interpreted as evidence about the STABILITY of the primary estimate, not as a reason to switch panels
pre-specify the divergence metric before unblinding

decision_register.title: WNT representation sensitivity
decision_register.current_frozen_state: median aggregation is primary; representative-IQR is the frozen sensitivity representation (Phase 2B)
decision_register.blocks_what: only the interpretation of a WNT coefficient, if one is reported
decision_register.implication: Between the two frozen representations the scores correlate E2F 0.998, EMT 0.992, P53 0.972, PI3K 0.910, WNT 0.858. WNT is the smallest set (41 genes) and the least internally coherent of the primary four, so each gene's probe choice matters more. A WNT result that does not hold under the sensitivity representation would be a representation artefact as much as a finding.
options_not_chosen: prespecify a full re-fit under the representative-IQR representation

decision_register.title: Prespecified batch sensitivity analysis
decision_register.current_frozen_state: no batch covariate in M1/M2/M3; no batch adjustment
decision_register.blocks_what: nothing; the primary model is unaffected either way
decision_register.implication: Batch LOCATION effects on PCs and on scores are fully explained by MMR composition (0/10 score tests survive stratification). Two signals do survive: AFFX control-probe PC1 ~ batch (p=0.0016) and PC2 DISPERSION ~ batch (p=0.0001). Neither is a location effect, so adding a batch covariate would not address them. Note also that batch, RNA extraction method and MMR are mutually confounded in this deposit, so no analysis here can separate them. ComBat was applied before deposit, so these are residuals in an already-corrected matrix - their absence elsewhere is not evidence that batch effects are absent.
options_not_chosen: prespecify a batch-stratified Cox as a sensitivity analysis

decision_register.title: combat_mod identity and the ComBat model matrix
decision_register.current_frozen_state: UNRESOLVED (Phase 7A Q1). Not used to impute MMR.
decision_register.blocks_what: nothing in the primary analysis; it limits provenance claims and any statement about what ComBat protected
decision_register.implication: combat_mod is perfectly concordant with recorded MMR across 519 SDRF tumour arrays (0 discordant). That is consistent with the depositors having used mmr.status in the ComBat model matrix, and equally with any variable that partitions these arrays identically. It is NOT proof of identity. The 43 S3 samples with MMR unrecorded are NOT imputed from it; A-19 complete-case remains frozen.
decision_register.outstanding_route: author correspondence with the CIT/GSE39582 depositors
options_not_chosen: leave unresolved and state the limitation

decision_register.title: Eight sex-axis-discordant samples
decision_register.current_frozen_state: RETAINED. Phase 7C D2 retains all 453; no relabelling.
decision_register.implication: Eight of 453 samples are discordant with recorded sex on both the Y-linked and the XIST axis, consistently across an 11-marker panel, spread over five batches. 3/8 carry a Phase 7C soft flag against 29/453 cohort-wide (OR 9.67, p=0.011), but a soft flag reports array quality, not identity. Expression markers cannot distinguish a sample or annotation mix-up from loss of Y or XIST silencing. GENOTYPE-LEVEL EVIDENCE IS UNAVAILABLE to this project.

decision_register.title: Endpoint limitations U1 and U2 (Phase 6A numbering)
decision_register.current_frozen_state: U1 `[PROVISIONAL: months]`; U2 published rule UNRESOLVED, deposited encoding is censoring-at-death and that censoring is demonstrably informative
decision_register.blocks_what: U1 blocks every FIXED-TIME absolute-risk analysis - t-year risk, predicted survival/CIF curves, cloglog calibration at a horizon, time-dependent AUC/Brier, and the 60-unit endpoint - unless explicitly labelled conditional (Phase 6A §3.1). Relative-risk analyses are unaffected. U2 constrains any analysis that treats death without recurrence as non-informative censoring, and motivates a competing-risks sensitivity analysis.
decision_register.naming_hazard: Phase 1 uses the labels U1 and U2 for DIFFERENT items (CIT446 stage vs M1; CIT106/CIT250 zero times). The Phase 6A numbering is the one used here and in the Phase 8A-8D reports. The collision is recorded, not resolved, because renumbering a historical report is out of scope.
options_not_chosen: proceed with relative-risk claims only (Phase 6A position)
attempt documentary resolution of the time unit

decision_register.title: External validation
decision_register.current_frozen_state: NO-GO for CEL acquisition (Phase 4 §6.2). No external expression data downloaded.
decision_register.blocks_what: any confirmatory external-validation claim. Internal validation by bootstrap optimism correction is unaffected.
decision_register.implication: Gate G4 FAILED on pre-specified criteria: GSE14333 has 48 events and GSE33113 has 18, against roughly 338 required at C=0.65 under an APPROXIMATION of the Riley framework (14% and 5% of requirement). Both remain EXPLORATORY candidates and their counts MUST NOT be combined. GSE33113 is a separate estimand - stage II only, a metastasis-or-recurrence composite, time in days. GSE17536 is excluded for established patient overlap with GSE14333. No suitable confirmatory cohort has been identified.
options_not_chosen: proceed with internal validation only and state the limitation
revisit the four D5 unlock conditions
